text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, had arrived. 
Compared to any race before, the 
excitement was on a completely different 
level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some spectators may judge Eishin Flash to 
be of lower caliber compared to other 
Umamusume... Yet her own stance remains 
entirely unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Just like always. Eyes fixed ahead, she 
headed toward the race.
